keyword: Balance your needs with someone else's
lead: 1221 is a mirror number: it reads the same forwards and backwards. It combines 1 (the self) and 2 (the other), so it is read as balance between your needs and someone else's. Its root is 6 (1+2+2+1), the number of care.
love: If you are single: 1221 favours a relationship where both people keep their own identity. Notice whether you lose yourself early in new connections. If you are in a relationship: 1221 points to fair give-and-take. It is a cue to check that both of you feel heard.
career: 1221 suits partnerships and roles where you balance leadership with cooperation.
steps: Write one need of yours and one of a person close to you.
